description: Header file defining the WebmWriter class for writing WebM media files, including methods for managing media sources, streams, and file metadata.

classes.name: WebmWriter
classes.description: A class for writing WebM media files, managing media sources, streams, and file metadata.

methods.name: isFdOpenModeValid
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is opened in a mode compatible with WebmWriter.

methods.name: WebmWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing WebmWriter with a file descriptor.

methods.name: ~WebmWriter
methods.description: Destructor that resets the WebmWriter state.

methods.name: addSource
methods.description: Adds a media source to the WebmWriter.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if the end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: setStartTimeOffsetMs
methods.description: Sets the start time offset in milliseconds.

methods.name: getStartTimeOffsetMs
methods.description: Returns the start time offset in milliseconds.

methods.name: numTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of media tracks.

methods.name: estimateCuesSize
methods.description: Estimates the size of cues based on bit rate.

methods.name: initStream
methods.description: Initializes a media stream at a given index.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the WebmWriter to initial state.
